fdroid:com.bivouac.app.name: Bivouac
fdroid:com.bivouac.app.summary: Plan multi-day hikes, relive and analyse the ones already done
fdroid:com.bivouac.app.description:
Bivouac splits a GPX track into stages around bivouac spots, then keeps every outing in a journal, with its photos and its figures. It is for before and after the outing: planning multi-day hikes, then reliving and analysing the ones already done.
Plan: import a GPX track of one or several days, place the bivouacs on the route. Distance, elevation and estimated duration are recalculated for each stage. Altitude and a weather link for each bivouac, export of a stage as GPX, a bank of prepared tracks.
Remember: keep every completed hike with a note, tags, and photos placed on the track where they were taken. The selection screen offers the photos taken during the hike first, with access to the whole gallery. Each photo can be cropped, captioned or moved along the track, and opens full screen.
Analyse: see your form on the day, the slope or the speed along the track, read each section, compare with the usual pace and with the estimate, separate walking time from breaks. A timeline of the outing shows climbs, descents and breaks, nights at the bivouac included.
Measure: totals, month-by-month progress and personal records, with actual duration and walking share. Each record leads back to the hike it comes from.
No account, no tracking, no collection:
* Everything on the device: tracks, journal and photos are stored on the device, with nothing sent to a server run by the developer.
* No account, no ads, no tracking: no usage statistics, no tracker, no crash reports.
* No location tracking: the app never accesses the device's location.
* Free software under the GPL-3.0 licence: the source code is public.
The app's only network connection: downloading map tiles. The satellite layer (Esri) and the weather link (Meteoblue), which are non-free services, are turned off by a single switch in Settings.
Photos: to place a photo on the track, Bivouac reads the GPS position stored in the photo. This needs read access to images and the "media location" permission, both requested only on first use of photos. The feature can be turned off in Settings, and photos never leave the device.
What Bivouac does not do: no guidance, no track recording, no social network. Tracks come from the watch, the GPS or the app used during the outing, in GPX format.
Interface in English and French, following the device's language. Android 8 and later.
Website: https://bivouac.rseb.net

fdroid:dev.linwood.butterfly.name: Butterfly
fdroid:dev.linwood.butterfly.summary: Take notes, draw freely, and organize ideas across an endless workspace
fdroid:dev.linwood.butterfly.description:
Butterfly is an open-source app for people who think better with space around their ideas. Instead of writing everything from top to bottom on a fixed page, you get an endless workspace where you can place notes, sketches, diagrams, images, and documents wherever they make sense.
Use it for class notes, meeting notes, research, math, worksheets, planning, whiteboarding, storyboards, product sketches, or any project that starts messy and needs room to grow. Write by hand with a stylus, touch, or mouse, type text and Markdown, add shapes and lines, place images and photos, import PDFs, SVGs, and image files, then export your work as PDF, SVG, images, or portable Butterfly files.
Butterfly tries to stay out of your way while you work. Recent files, quick-start templates, search, folders, imports, page navigation, and tool settings are close when you need them, but the document stays at the center. You can begin with a plain page, ruled paper, a grid, dotted paper, music paper, or your own template.
As your document grows, Butterfly gives you ways to keep it understandable. Split work into pages and page folders, use layers, mark important places with areas and waypoints, save reusable parts in packs, and keep palettes and text styles ready for the next document. Almost everything you add remains editable, so you can move, resize, recolor, reorder, and refine your work later instead of starting over.
Your files stay under your control. Work offline, store documents on your device, choose a different data directory, or connect WebDAV and Nextcloud if you want your own sync setup. There is no required account, no required subscription, and no required proprietary cloud.
Butterfly is free, community translated, available on phones, tablets, desktops, and the web, and developed in public under the AGPL-3.0 license.

fdroid:info.guardianproject.ripple.summary: Trigger apps to protect your privacy when in anxious or panic situations
fdroid:info.guardianproject.ripple.description:
Ripple is a "panic button" that can send it's trigger message to any app that is a "panic responder". Such apps can do things like lock, disguise themselves, delete private data, send an emergency message, and more. It is meant for situations where there is time to react, but where users need to be sure it is not mistakenly set off.
This is a BETA version of this app! We are working now to add support to as many other apps as possible. ChatSecure, Orweb, Umbrella, and Zom already have support, these apps are coming soon: Courier, PanicButton, OpenKeychain, Orfox, SMSSecure, StoryMaker.
Here are two example scenarios:
* An organization gets regularly raided by the security forces, who search all of the computers and mobile devices on the premises. The organization usually has at least a minute or two of warning before a raid starts. They need a very reliable way to trigger wiping all of the data from the sensitive apps.
* An aid worker has lots of sensitive data about people on their device. They regularly sync that data to a secure, central database. Occasionally, the aid worker has to leave the country on very short notice. The border guards regularly download the entire contents of mobile devices of people crossing through. While waiting in line at the border, the aid worker sees the border guards seizing people's devices, and then remembers all the data on the device, so she unlocks the phone and hits the wipe trigger, which wipes all sensitive apps from the device. When the aid worker returns to the central office, the device is again synced up with the central database.

Gruzzolo turns saving into an honest game: it rewards only money you actually set aside and keep there. The interface is available in English and Italian.
 How it works 
• Pick a goal and a regular commitment, weekly or monthly.
• Log deposits by hand, or import your bank statement.
• The commitment is net of withdrawals: depositing and taking it straight back does not count.
• Each period you hit extends your streak. A joker covers one missed period.
 Rewards 
• 14 collectible medals, each in bronze, silver and gold.
• Three new missions every period.
• Levels, personal records and one medal to keep on display.
• No random rewards: everything depends on what you do.
 Spending 
• Reads the N26 PDF statement (Italian-language statements) and the Revolut CSV export.
• Shows categories, merchants, recurring subscriptions and where you can act.
• Monthly caps per category: what is left under a cap can be moved to savings.
 Privacy 
• The app does not request the Internet permission: it cannot send anything.
• Files are read on the phone. Only the transactions are stored, without IBANs.
• No ads, no tracking, no account.
• Backup to a file you choose.
 What it does not do 
Gruzzolo does not move money and does not connect to your bank. It is not affiliated with N26 or Revolut.

fdroid:io.github.jbinder.sprawlrun.name: SPRAWL//RUN
fdroid:io.github.jbinder.sprawlrun.summary: A running tracker wrapped in a cyberpunk story that chases you. Fully offline.
fdroid:io.github.jbinder.sprawlrun.description:
Your running app should not be a spreadsheet. It should be chasing you.
SPRAWL//RUN is a gamified running tracker wrapped around two ten-mission cyberpunk campaigns. In Sprawl Prime you are a courier in a rain-slick megacity: a job on the Ninsei strip turns into carrying something that will not stop transmitting, and ends forty floors up a corporate arcology with an intelligence that has spent nineteen years counting a heartbeat that was not there. In Null Tide the southern districts are under water, something in a pump house has been apologising for nine seconds a night, and a salvage broker needs a piece of paper carried across the Drowned Mile before the sea comes home.
Bring whatever you normally listen to. Every few minutes the app takes over the audio: a radio squelch, your music drops out, and your handler talks. Then it hands your music back. Eleven characters across the story packs, each with a distinct synthesised voice, so you know who is speaking with the phone in your pocket.
SOMEBODY IS CHASING YOU

firefox-addons:3126129.name: Tab Order Accessibility – Focus Order Map
firefox-addons:3126129.summary: See the keyboard tab order of any page as numbered stops and arrows. Pro: tabindex and focus trap warnings, report export.
firefox-addons:3126129.description:
See where the keyboard goes on any website. One click puts a number on every element you can reach with the Tab key and draws arrows between them, so a broken sequence is obvious at a glance. The map is free with no limit and needs no account. Pro costs $5.99 once, no subscription.
WHAT IT DOES
Open a site, click the toolbar icon and press "Show tab order". Links, buttons, form fields and custom widgets get their position in the sequence, the way the browser really moves through them: elements with a positive tabindex first, then the rest in document order, skipping disabled, hidden and inert ones. A list in the popup names each stop by role and accessible name. With Pro you also get warnings for common mistakes, a recorder that catches keyboard traps, and a report to share.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Open the site you want to check.
2. Click the extension in the toolbar and press "Show tab order".
3. Follow the numbers and arrows, or pick an entry in the list to scroll to that element.
FREE
• Numbered badges on every focusable element of the current page.
• Arrows between consecutive stops; dashed arrows show where the sequence jumps back up.
• A list of all stops with role and accessible name. Choose one to highlight it.
• The map updates when the site changes, for example after a menu opens.
PRO ($5.99, LIFETIME)
• Warnings for a tabindex above 0, focusable elements inside aria-hidden, and controls without an accessible name.
• Focus trap finder: record your own Tab presses and see when focus keeps looping between a few elements and never reaches the rest.
• Report export as CSV or Markdown with every stop, its role, name, tabindex and warnings.
PRIVACY
The extension touches a page only when you click its icon. Badges and arrows only change how the open page looks and disappear when you hide them or reload. Nothing about the sites you check is stored or uploaded. The only data sent anywhere is the email you enter to buy or restore Pro, which is checked against the payment.
Questions: scanlystudio.support@proton.me

firefox-addons:777527.name: tabzen
firefox-addons:777527.summary:
Too many open tabs? Manage your tabs, regain your sanity and improve your browsing experience with tabzen.
Save and restore your tabs whenever you need them.
Edit, annotate and organize your tabs. 
Export, import to and from HTML file.
firefox-addons:777527.description:
Save and restore your tabs whenever you need them.
Your saved tabs are organized in the familiar file system fashion. Similar to the browser bookmarks manager.
 Features 
 Organize your tabs in folders
 Fuzzy search to easily find items even if you don't know the exact spelling
 Omnibar search. Simply type "tz keyword" into the address bar to search for "keyword" in your saved tabs
 Select from the suggested results or press enter for more results
 Drag and drop URLs and folder
 Edit and add comment to URLs and folder
 Export your saved tab to bookmarks HTML file
 Import form bookmarks HTML file
 Pinned tabs are reopened pinned
 Tabs saved from private session reopen in private window by default
 USAGE 
Access the popup menu by clicking on the Tabzen logo on the toolbar, to the right of the address bar.
The menu lists the open tabs and windows. 
Add and remove from your saved tabs. 
Conveniently switch between tabs and windows
 Shortcuts 
 Alt+Shift+T Open tab manager
 Alt+Shift+A Save tabs in all opened windows
 Alt+T Save current tab
 Alt+A Save all tabs in current window
Tabzen does not access anything other than your saved tabs.
Tabzen does not access any external resources except for the Favicons for your saved tab generated by duckduckgo.com

firefox-addons:3068097.name: Pixel Pond Animated Theme
firefox-addons:3068097.summary: A tranquil pixel-art animated koi pond theme for Firefox. Features 6 atmospheric palettes with seamless 16-frame loops, drifting snow, expanding water ripples, and sleek dark browser styling.
firefox-addons:3068097.description:
Transform your Firefox header into a tranquil animated Japanese koi pond. Pixel Pond combines handcrafted 16-frame pixel art loops, dynamic weather effects like drifting snow and expanding rain ripples, and 6 carefully tuned dark color themes.
6 Atmospheric Themes
• Deep Pond — Calm night waters with swimming vermillion Kohaku and golden koi. 
• Cherry Blossom — Spring dawn with floating sakura petals and soft pink accents. 
• Midnight — Moonlit celestial pool with glowing cyan water and midnight blues. 
• Ember — Autumn hearth mood with warm embers and blazing flame highlights. 
• Winter — Frosty pond waters featuring multi-layer animated snowfall and icy blues. 
• Rainy — Soothing drizzle with slanted rain streaks and expanding ripple rings.
Thoughtful Browser Styling
Every theme includes coordinated dark-mode color palettes for the window frame, tabs, address bar, buttons, and sidebars to ensure high contrast, readability, and low eye strain.
Features
• Handcrafted 16-Frame Animation: Smooth, seamless looping pixel art that tiles across widescreen displays. 
• Instant Theme Switching: Switch between all 6 palettes with one click from the toolbar popup. 
• Pure Native Performance: Uses the native Firefox WebExtension Theme API with zero background overhead or memory drain. 
• 100% Private: Operates completely offline with zero telemetry and zero data collection. 
• Cross-Platform: Designed for both Desktop and Firefox for Android.

apple-itunes:722217471.description:
Hidden City is a hidden object detective adventure for players who enjoy cozy mystery games, search-and-find puzzles, story-rich quests and richly detailed scenes. Explore a mystical Victorian city, find hidden objects, follow clues, solve puzzles, meet unique characters and uncover magical secrets in the City of Shadows.
Your next investigation awaits in a game where detective cases, beautiful search scenes, puzzle variety and magical events blend into one captivating mystery story. Look closer, collect clues and discover why every object, note and artifact matters.
What will you investigate?
Search atmospheric scenes filled with hidden items, evidence, notes, artifacts, keys, symbols, curiosities and visual clues. Every location invites careful observation and rewards players who love to find meaningful details in beautiful environments.
Explore foggy streets, ornate halls, manor-like rooms, curious shops, gardens, arcades, laboratories and magical city districts. Each place supports the mystery and turns object search into part of the investigation.
Which search modes can you play?
Hidden City keeps the main investigation fresh with different modes designed to test your observation skills:
• Words mode: Classic hidden object searching using text lists.
• Silhouettes mode: Visual challenges based on object shapes.
• Night mode: Focused searches in dim scenes using a spotlight.
• Pairs mode: Matching identical or logically related objects to test your attention.
These modes support players who enjoy search-and-find adventures, visual puzzles, detective games and finding hidden items through careful observation.
Are there mini-games and puzzles?
Yes. The core search mechanics are supported by puzzle modes that add variety without taking over the main experience. Take a break from the investigation and play through:
• Spot the difference: Compare two scenes using sharp observation.
• Match-3 levels: Crystal and gem matching for satisfying puzzle breaks.
• Brain teasers: Logic mini-games, memory challenges and story-driven riddles.
This mix works well for players who want a detective game with brain teasers, a mystery puzzle with clues or a search-and-find adventure with match-3 elements.
How does the story unfold?
Follow narrative-driven quests, character stories, special cases and event investigations. Assemble artifact collections, solve anomalies, complete requests and unlock rewards that help you continue your detective journey.
Every quest connects detailed scenes, puzzle challenges, magical discoveries and story progression into one polished mystery adventure.
Play Hidden City your way
• Play offline: Continue your investigation anywhere, even without an internet connection.
• Follow the story: Return to character quests, detective cases and magical events as your mystery unfolds.
• Regular updates: Discover new cases, quests, search scenes and special events added over time.
• Cross-device sync: Save your progress and switch between your devices.
While this game is absolutely free to play, you have the ability to unlock optional bonuses via in-app purchases from within the game. You may disable in-app purchases in your device settings.
You can play this game even if you’re offline!

apple-macos:6761850487.description:
Caliu is a quiet place to write. Open it and start typing: no account, no setup, no clutter. Markdown takes shape as you type, everything works offline, and your notes stay on your device.
When you want them everywhere, create a free account and they follow you across iPhone, iPad, Mac and the web. Sync is free, and it stays free.
Writing comes first
Headings, lists, tasks, quotes, code and links format as you write. There is no preview pane and no mode to switch: what you see is your note. The interface steps aside and leaves you with the page.
Organised the way you think
Tags instead of folders, because one idea can belong in many places. Nest them, colour them, and find any note in seconds. Link notes to each other and follow a thought from one to the next. Pin what matters now, and archive what you are done with without losing a word.
There when you need it
Native on iPhone, iPad and Mac, with a web app for everything else. Save things to Caliu straight from the share sheet, or add a thought from your Apple Watch.
Yours, and only yours
No ads. No tracking. Nothing you write is used to train AI. Your notes live on your device first and sync encrypted, and Caliu is built in the EU under GDPR. Export any note as Markdown or plain text whenever you like, share one as a public link when someone needs to read it, and delete your account at any time. Deleted means deleted.
For tinkerers
A full REST API and a built-in MCP server, so Claude, Cursor or your own scripts can read and write your notes, on your terms. Your first API key is free.
Caliu Pro
Writing, tags, sync and working offline are free. 50 notes free, forever, no account needed. Caliu Pro makes them unlimited and adds:
• Version history: scroll back through any note and restore it in a tap
• Every theme, font and app icon: 22 colour themes, each in light and dark, and 30 fonts
• Drawing, right inside your notes
• Unlimited attachments
• More export formats: HTML, ePub, PDF, RTF and TextPack
• Unlimited API keys, and connecting AI apps like Claude to your notes
Subscribe monthly or yearly, or buy Pro lifetime once. Try it free before you decide. The monthly or yearly plan is an auto-renewing subscription: it renews unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and you can manage or cancel it anytime in your App Store account settings.
Made with care by a small, independent team of one.
